ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { customer: payload."0".payload.data, orders: payload."1".payload.data, loyalty: payload."2".payload.data, correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log Payment Route
logger.message: #['[ROUTING] CorrelationId: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | Routing to payment processor']

logger.doc:name: Log Refund Route
logger.message: #['[ROUTING] CorrelationId: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | Routing to refund processor']

logger.doc:name: Log Transfer Route
logger.message: #['[ROUTING] CorrelationId: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | Routing to transfer processor']

logger.doc:name: Log Unknown Route
logger.message: #['[ROUTING] CorrelationId: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | Unknown type, using default processor']

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "UNKNOWN_TYPE", message: "Type de transaction inconnu: " ++ payload.type, correlationId: vars.correlationId }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "PAYMENT_PROCESSED", transactionId: uuid(), amount: payload.amount, message: "Paiement traité avec succès", correlationId: vars.correlationId }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "REFUND_PROCESSED", transactionId: uuid(), amount: payload.amount, message: "Remboursement traité avec succès", correlationId: vars.correlationId }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "TRANSFER_PROCESSED", transactionId: uuid(), amount: payload.amount, fromAccount: payload.fromAccount, toAccount: payload.toAccount, message: "Virement traité avec succès", correlationId: vars.correlationId }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- false // Simuler : message non traité

logger.doc:name: Log Duplicate
logger.message: #['[IDEMPOTENT] CorrelationId: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | Message ' ++ vars.messageId ++ ' already processed']

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "DUPLICATE", message: "Ce message a déjà été traité", messageId: vars.messageId, correlationId: vars.correlationId }

logger.doc:name: Log New Message
logger.message: #['[IDEMPOTENT] CorrelationId: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | Processing new message ' ++ vars.messageId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "PROCESSED", message: "Message traité avec succès", messageId: vars.messageId, data: payload, correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log Save Message ID
logger.message: #['[IDEMPOTENT] Saving message ID ' ++ vars.messageId ++ ' to prevent duplicates']

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var batchSize = p('business.batchSize') as Number --- // Divise les données en lots payload.items groupBy ((item, index) -> floor(index / batchSize))

logger.doc:name: Log Batch Info
logger.message: #['[BATCH] CorrelationId: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | Processing ' ++ vars.totalItems ++ ' items in ' ++ sizeOf(payload) ++ ' batches']

logger.doc:name: Log Batch
logger.message: #['[BATCH] CorrelationId: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | Processing batch with ' ++ sizeOf(payload) ++ ' items']

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "BATCH_COMPLETED", totalItemsProcessed: vars.totalItems, correlationId: vars.correlationId, completedAt: now() }
